content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"B2B cloud telephony and web hosting for small businesses; no consumer banking or cash advance overlap."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"B2B billing and customer care software for telecom and media operators; different business entirely."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"B2B payment processing and outsourced IT for banks and merchants; not consumer banking or advances."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Store-based secured pawn loans and used merchandise resale; different model from app-based banking and advances."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Mainly consumer cybersecurity and identity protection subscriptions; personal finance is a secondary add-on."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Small business accounting, tax and payroll software; consumer personal finance is a minor part."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"B2B identity verification and mobile deposit software sold to banks; not a consumer banking provider."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"B2B AI lending network connecting lenders and investors; does not serve consumers directly with accounts."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Buys and collects charged-off consumer debt; collections business, not consumer banking or cash advances."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"B2B merchant payment processing and payables automation for small businesses; different customers and model."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Institutional investment processing, fund administration and asset management for financial firms; not consumer banking."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Institutional financial software and back-office outsourcing for asset managers and banks; different customers."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Physical cash-in-transit, ATM services and security equipment for banks and retailers; not consumer app banking."}]}
